data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B autonomous systems company in the Drones & Autonomous sector. The target has raised $41.7M to date. The broader comp universe includes eight private peers across drones and autonomous systems, notably Elroy Air, Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, and Archer Aviation. No direct public comparables exist in this subsector.

The valuation analysis relies on a stage-progression methodology, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to growth-stage transitions. Using the $41.7M raised as a baseline proxy, this approach yields an implied valuation of $79M. A peer-median approach was not applicable; while five same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier comps) could not support a statistically meaningful subset of three or more datapoints, rendering a peer-based multiple unreliable for this stage and subsector.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $67M to $91M, with a median point of $79M. This range incorporates conservatism around the single-method finding. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 1.9x multiplier for this specific subsector and stage; broader dispersion in autonomous systems company trajectories could warrant adjustment. Additionally, the sparse peer set underscores reliance on stage-based progression rather than market-derived multiples. Updated financials or operational milestones would strengthen conviction in the range.
